label: ColE1
note: The ColE1/pMB1-family origin of replication: the 589 bp region from the RNA II promoter -35 to the DNA replication start, carrying the convergent RNA I / RNA II promoter pair that sets plasmid copy number.

label: RNA II promoter -35
note: Top-strand -35 hexamer (TTGAGA) of the RNA II promoter, which drives the ColE1/pMB1 replication pre-primer transcript.

label: RNA II promoter -10
note: Top-strand -10 hexamer (CGTAAT) of the RNA II promoter, 15 bp downstream of the -35.

label: RNA I promoter -35
note: -35 hexamer of the convergent RNA I promoter on the bottom strand.

label: RNA I promoter -10
note: -10 hexamer of the RNA I promoter on the bottom strand.

provenance.sequence_source: ColE1/pMB1-family origin; 100% identical to GenBank J01749 (pBR322; Sutcliffe 1979) and L08752 (pUC18; Yanisch-Perron 1985). Refined 2 bp (positions 393-394 (1-based)) to these canonical deposits. The pUC- and pBR322-type origins are sequence-identical across this fragment; the high- vs medium-copy difference is set by the separate rop part, not this sequence. Re-delimited (2026-11) from a 792 bp fragment to pBR322 (J01749) 2534-3122, minus strand: the old fragment also carried 20 bp of backbone on the bla side and the 183 bp past the RNA-to-DNA transition (pBR322 2351-2533, carrying the L-strand primosome assembly site and a DnaA box), now the separate part pBR322_pas_DnaA.

functional_claims.label: High-copy ColE1/pMB1 origin; copy number set by the RNA I/RNA II antisense system.

source.quote: The ColE1/pMB1-family origin of replication: the 589 bp region from the RNA II promoter -35 to the DNA replication start, carrying the convergent RNA I / RNA II promoter pair that sets plasmid copy number.

functional_claims.label: Spans pBR322 2534-3122 (minus strand): from the RNA II promoter -35 to the RNA-to-DNA transition. The part ends at pBR322 2534, inside the run of five A residues where the primer RNA turns into DNA, one base before the three consecutive nucleotides (dA, dA, dC; pBR322 2533-2531) at which DNA synthesis starts. The ColE1 deposit J01566 marks this start at its base 1197 (+/- 1), = pBR322 2532; J01749's uncited rep_origin at 2535 is 2 bp upstream.

value.end: RNA-to-DNA transition: the base before the DNA start nucleotides (pBR322 2533-2531)

source.quote: The site is one of three consecutive nucleotides, dA, dA, and dC, located at a unique position. ... The transition from the primer RNA to DNA occurs in a region consisting of a segment of five A residues.
